title: The Myth of Loyalty at Work
hook: Being loyal to a company is the fastest way to get replaced.
theme: Corporate realism, replaced worker, silent exploitation

title: People Don't Want Truth, They Want Theater
hook: People do not hate corruption. They just hate that it is not their turn yet.

title: The Kingmaker Dilemma
hook: If she supported you when you were broke, leave her when you become rich. Release the Kingmaker.

title: Why Nice Guys Finish Last
hook: Being agreeable is not kindness. It is cowardice wearing perfume.
theme: Assertiveness, dark psychology, respect vs pleasing

title: The Trap of Middle-Class Comfort
hook: A comfortable salary is the drug employers give you to forget your dreams.

title: The Power of Calculated Silence
hook: The loudest person in the room is always the most desperate for validation.

title: The Myth of Karma
hook: Karma is the comforting fairy tale weak men tell themselves to avoid fighting back.
theme: Realpolitik, harsh justice, strength vs waiting

title: Why Flashing Wealth Keeps You Broke
hook: Poor people buy luxury to look rich. Rich people stay invisible to stay wealthy.
theme: Stealth wealth, consumer trap, ego tax

title: Conditional Affection
hook: Nobody loves you for who you are. They love what you bring to the table.
theme: Transactional bonds, value, unconditional love myth

title: The Crowd Always Chooses Barabbas
hook: Never seek justice from a crowd. A mob does not want truth, it wants blood.
